macros.name: blcircle
macros.doc: The centrum of the circular arc is positioned strictly at the point which is the argument of the corresponding \put.

macros.name: BLcircle
macros.doc: The commands \TRcircle, \BRcircle, \TLcircle, \BLcircle draw the 90◦ circular quaters with the reference point positioned at the corner instead of the centrum.

macros.name: BRcircle

macros.name: DiskCorner
macros.doc: set the diameter for the bulbs at the corners of black shadows with rounded corners.

macros.name: frameBox
macros.doc: The ordinary solid frame is drawn by \frameBox, the double and triple frames are drawn by \frameBoX and \frameBOX, respectively.

macros.name: frameBOX
macros.doc: The ordinary solid frame is drawn by \frameBox, the double and triple frames are drawn by \frameBoX and \frameBOX, respectively.

macros.name: LineCorner
macros.doc: set the length for the inclined corners of octal frames and shadows.

macros.name: RectCorner
macros.doc: set the size for the parquette corners of octal frames and shadows.

macros.name: RoundCorner
macros.doc: set the radius for the circular arcs at the corners of oval frames and shadows with rounded corners.

macros.name: shadowcorner
macros.doc: set the corner for the shadows.

macros.name: shadowsep
macros.doc: set the gap distance between the frame and the shadow or between multiple shadows.

macros.name: shadowshrink
macros.doc: set the contraction factor for the subsequent shadows.

macros.name: shadowsize
macros.doc: set the depth of the shadow.
